body:
- Fixed a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit targets when the size of a formatting buffer overflows, e.g. `fmt::format(L"{:>{}}", s, 1100000000)`. Such allocations now throw `std::bad_alloc`.

- Fixed an out-of-bounds read when parsing format specifiers of `std::error_code` (https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/pull/4934). Thanks @IfkumRfnl.

- Fixed a crash when formatting `nullptr` with `FMT_COMPILE` and an exception in `fmt::to_string(nullptr)`; both now format it as `0x0` (https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/pull/4993). Thanks @INo-xious.
